grammar.pattern: 量词重叠：个个 / 本本 / 张张等
grammar.purpose: Read distribution within a stated set
grammar.explanation: 这六张纸张张都有名字 means each of these six sheets bears a name; it does not prove every sheet anywhere is named. 本本都读过 ranges over the books just mentioned. Not every classifier repeats equally naturally in all contexts; use 个个/本本/张张 with a clear noun or preceding set. Compare 每张 rather than invent a new total from repetition.

examples.zh: 这六张纸，张张都有名字。

examples.en: Each of these six sheets bears a name.

commonMistakes.wrong: 张张有名字，所以世界上所有纸都有名字。
commonMistakes.right: 这六张纸张张有名字，只说这六张。
commonMistakes.why: The distributive scope remains the stated set.

grammar.pattern: 数词 + 量词重复：一个一个 / 一张一张
grammar.purpose: Read sequential handling and context-dependent distribution
grammar.explanation: 一张一张递 describes passing sheets one at a time. 两张两张发 distributes or handles two at a time; with six sheets this means three batches, not two total sheets. 一人一张 states individual allocation and has a different pattern. Repetition alone does not establish the overall quantity or completion.

examples.zh: 把六张纸一张一张递过来。
examples.py: bǎ liù zhāng zhǐ yī zhāng yī zhāng dì guò lái .
examples.en: Pass the six sheets over one at a time.

examples.en: Distribute them two at a time, six in total.

examples.zh: 一人一张，六个人要六张。
examples.py: yī rén yī zhāng , liù gè rén yào liù zhāng .
examples.en: One sheet per person: six people need six sheets.

commonMistakes.wrong: 两张两张发，所以一共只有两张。
commonMistakes.right: 两张两张发是方式，总数还要看说明。
commonMistakes.why: Batch size is not total quantity.

dialogue.title: Six sheets, two groups
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Track total, group and person quantities.

lines.zh: 整个小组六个人，现在有几张纸？
lines.py: zhěng gè xiǎo zǔ liù gè rén , xiàn zài yǒu jǐ zhāng zhǐ ?
lines.en: There are six in the whole group; how many sheets are here?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 四张，还缺两张。
lines.py: sì zhāng , hái quē liǎng zhāng .
lines.en: Four; two are still missing.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我再拿两张，六张就齐了。
lines.py: wǒ zài ná liǎng zhāng , liù zhāng jiù qí le .
lines.en: I will get two more, making all six present.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 两组分别拿三张，一人一张。
lines.py: liǎng zǔ fēn bié ná sān zhāng , yī rén yī zhāng .
lines.en: The two groups each take three, one per person.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我一张一张递，你配合记数量。
lines.py: wǒ yī zhāng yī zhāng dì , nǐ pèi hé jì shù liàng .
lines.en: I pass one at a time; help record the quantity.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 这六张，张张都有名字。活动收费吗？
lines.py: zhè liù zhāng , zhāng zhāng dōu yǒu míng zì . huó dòng shōu fèi ma ?
lines.en: Each of these six has a name. Does the event charge a fee?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 不收费，人民币也不用付。
lines.py: bù shōu fèi , rén mín bì yě bù yòng fù .
lines.en: No charge and no renminbi payment needed.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，纸齐不等于人都到了，最后核对名单。
lines.py: hǎo , zhǐ qí bù děng yú rén dōu dào le , zuì hòu hé duì míng dān .
lines.en: Okay; all sheets present does not mean all people arrived. Check the list last.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 整个小组六个人，原来四张纸，再拿两张，共六张。

lines.py: yī zhāng yī zhāng dì shuō fāng shì , bù shì shuō zhǐ yǒu yī zhāng .

lines.zh: 这六张纸张张都有名字，只说这六张。
lines.py: zhè liù zhāng zhǐ zhāng zhāng dōu yǒu míng zì , zhǐ shuō zhè liù zhāng .
lines.en: Each of these six sheets has a name; only these six are described.

lines.zh: 内容丰富，也不用一次读完整本书。
lines.py: nèi róng fēng fù , yě bù yòng yī cì dú wán zhěng běn shū .

lines.zh: 两组配合可以满足需要，缺少信息就再问。
lines.py: liǎng zǔ pèi hé kě yǐ mǎn zú xū yào , quē shǎo xìn xī jiù zài wèn .

lines.zh: 双方说活动不收费，不需要交费和支付。
lines.py: shuāng fāng shuō huó dòng bù shōu fèi , bù xū yào jiāo fèi hé zhī fù .
lines.en: Both parties say the event is free; no fee or payment is needed.

lines.zh: 全面看整体，也看个人；美好的安排要把名单核对齐。
lines.py: quán miàn kàn zhěng tǐ , yě kàn gè rén ; měi hǎo de ān pái yào bǎ míng dān hé duì qí .
lines.en: Consider the whole and each individual; a good arrangement checks the full list.
